topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The air whispers secrets through the leaves, and something new colors the day. Shapes of life, not quite familiar, catch the eye and the breath. Petals unfurl where they shouldn't, where the earth speaks of soil and root, these speak of sky and cloud. No scent of predator here, no shadow of flight. Just the gentle press of color against the world's green tapestry. I step closer, every sense stretching, reaching. The quiet of the forest holds its breath, and in this moment, the silent language of the woods finds a new verse. These flowers, they stand as messengers, though what they carry, the breeze might only guess. They are here, and that changes everything.
